speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
ईर्षुर्घृणी नसन्तुष्टः क्रोधनो नित्यशङ्कितः ।
परभाग्योपजीवी च षडेते नित्यदुःखिताः ॥
iast:
īrṣurghṛṇī nasantuṣṭaḥ krodhano nityaśaṅkitaḥ |
parabhāgyopajīvī ca ṣaḍete nityaduḥkhitāḥ ||
english: The envious, the fastidious, the discontented, the quick to anger, the always suspicious, and the one who lives on another's fortune: these six are always unhappy.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
सप्त दोषाः सदा राज्ञा हातव्या व्यसनोदयाः ।
प्रायशो यैर्विनश्यन्ति कृतमूलाश्च पार्थिवाः ॥
iast:
sapta doṣāḥ sadā rājñā hātavyā vyasanodayāḥ |
prāyaśo yairvinaśyanti kṛtamūlāśca pārthivāḥ ||
english: A king should always give up seven faults that give rise to calamity, by which even firmly rooted rulers are mostly destroyed:

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
स्त्रियोऽक्षा मृगया पानं वाक्पारुष्यं च पञ्चमम् ।
महच्च दण्डपारुष्यमर्थदूषणमेव च ॥
iast:
striyo'kṣā mṛgayā pānaṃ vākpāruṣyaṃ ca pañcamam |
mahacca daṇḍapāruṣyamarthadūṣaṇameva ca ||
english: women, dice, hunting, drinking, harsh speech as the fifth, great harshness in punishment, and misuse of wealth.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
अष्टौ पूर्वनिमित्तानि नरस्य विनशिष्यतः ।
ब्राह्मणान्प्रथमं द्वेष्टि ब्राह्मणैश्च विरुध्यते ॥
iast:
aṣṭau pūrvanimittāni narasya vinaśiṣyataḥ |
brāhmaṇānprathamaṃ dveṣṭi brāhmaṇaiśca virudhyate ||
english: There are eight signs of a man about to be destroyed: first, he hates brahmins and is at odds with brahmins;

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
ब्राह्मण स्वानि चादत्ते ब्राह्मणांश्च जिघांसति ।
रमते निन्दया चैषां प्रशंसां नाभिनन्दति ॥
iast:
brāhmaṇa svāni cādatte brāhmaṇāṃśca jighāṃsati |
ramate nindayā caiṣāṃ praśaṃsāṃ nābhinandati ||
english: he takes brahmins' property and wishes to kill brahmins; he delights in blaming them and does not welcome their praise;

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
नैतान्स्मरति कृत्येषु याचितश्चाभ्यसूयति ।
एतान्दोषान्नरः प्राज्ञो बुद्ध्या बुद्ध्वा विवर्जयेत् ॥
iast:
naitānsmarati kṛtyeṣu yācitaścābhyasūyati |
etāndoṣānnaraḥ prājño buddhyā buddhvā vivarjayet ||
english: he does not remember them in his rites, and resents them when asked. A wise person, understanding these faults, should avoid them.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
अष्टाविमानि हर्षस्य नव नीतानि भारत ।
वर्तमानानि दृश्यन्ते तान्येव सुसुखान्यपि ॥
iast:
aṣṭāvimāni harṣasya nava nītāni bhārata |
vartamānāni dṛśyante tānyeva susukhānyapi ||
english: These eight, Bharata, are the very cream of joy, seen in the present, and they are true happiness:

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
समागमश्च सखिभिर्महांश्चैव धनागमः ।
पुत्रेण च परिष्वङ्गः संनिपातश्च मैथुने ॥
iast:
samāgamaśca sakhibhirmahāṃścaiva dhanāgamaḥ |
putreṇa ca pariṣvaṅgaḥ saṃnipātaśca maithune ||
english: meeting with friends, a great gain of wealth, embracing one's son, union in love-making,

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
समये च प्रियालापः स्वयूथेषु च संनतिः ।
अभिप्रेतस्य लाभश्च पूजा च जनसंसदि ॥
iast:
samaye ca priyālāpaḥ svayūtheṣu ca saṃnatiḥ |
abhipretasya lābhaśca pūjā ca janasaṃsadi ||
english: kind conversation at the right time, standing high among one's own people, gaining what one wishes, and honour in an assembly.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
अष्टौ गुणाः पुरुषं दीपयन्ति
प्रज्ञा च कौल्यं च दमः श्रुतं च ।
पराक्रमश्चाबहुभाषिता च
दानं यथाशक्ति कृतज्ञता च ॥
iast:
aṣṭau guṇāḥ puruṣaṃ dīpayanti
prajñā ca kaulyaṃ ca damaḥ śrutaṃ ca |
parākramaścābahubhāṣitā ca
dānaṃ yathāśakti kṛtajñatā ca ||
english: Eight qualities make a person shine: wisdom, good family, self-control, learning, courage, not talking too much, giving according to one's means, and gratitude.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
नवद्वारमिदं वेश्म त्रिस्थूणं पञ्च साक्षिकम् ।
क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितं विद्वान्यो वेद स परः कविः ॥
iast:
navadvāramidaṃ veśma tristhūṇaṃ pañca sākṣikam |
kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṃ vidvānyo veda sa paraḥ kaviḥ ||
english: This house has nine doors, three pillars and five witnesses, and the knower of the field presides over it. The wise one who knows this is the supreme seer.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
दश धर्मं न जानन्ति धृतराष्ट्र निबोध तान् ।
मत्तः प्रमत्त उन्मत्तः श्रान्तः क्रुद्धो बुभुक्षितः ॥
iast:
daśa dharmaṃ na jānanti dhṛtarāṣṭra nibodha tān |
mattaḥ pramatta unmattaḥ śrāntaḥ kruddho bubhukṣitaḥ ||
english: Ten do not know dharma, Dhritarashtra; learn them: the drunk, the careless, the mad, the exhausted, the angry, the hungry,

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
त्वरमाणश्च भीरुश्च लुब्धः कामी च ते दश ।
तस्मादेतेषु भावेषु न प्रसज्जेत पण्डितः ॥
iast:
tvaramāṇaśca bhīruśca lubdhaḥ kāmī ca te daśa |
tasmādeteṣu bhāveṣu na prasajjeta paṇḍitaḥ ||
english: the hasty, the timid, the greedy and the lustful: these are the ten. So the wise should not get attached to these states.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ।
पुत्रार्थमसुरेन्द्रेण गीतं चैव सुधन्वना ॥
iast:
atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam |
putrārthamasurendreṇa gītaṃ caiva sudhanvanā ||
english: On this they cite an ancient story, sung by the lord of the asuras for his son's sake, and by Sudhanva.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
यः काममन्यू प्रजहाति राजा
पात्रे प्रतिष्ठापयते धनं च ।
विशेषविच्छ्रुतवान्क्षिप्रकारी
तं सर्वलोकः कुरुते प्रमाणम् ॥
iast:
yaḥ kāmamanyū prajahāti rājā
pātre pratiṣṭhāpayate dhanaṃ ca |
viśeṣavicchrutavānkṣiprakārī
taṃ sarvalokaḥ kurute pramāṇam ||
english: The king who gives up desire and anger, places wealth with the worthy, discerns differences, is learned and acts quickly, is taken as an authority by all.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
जानाति विश्वासयितुं मनुष्यान्
विज्ञात दोषेषु दधाति दण्डम् ।
जानाति मात्रां च तथा क्षमां च
तं तादृशं श्रीर्जुषते समग्रा ॥
iast:
jānāti viśvāsayituṃ manuṣyān
vijñāta doṣeṣu dadhāti daṇḍam |
jānāti mātrāṃ ca tathā kṣamāṃ ca
taṃ tādṛśaṃ śrīrjuṣate samagrā ||
english: One who knows how to win people's trust, punishes only where faults are proven, and knows both measure and forgiveness: such a person full prosperity attends.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
सुदुर्बलं नावजानाति कंचिद्-
युक्तो रिपुं सेवते बुद्धिपूर्वम् ।
न विग्रहं रोचयते बलस्थैः
काले च यो विक्रमते स धीरः ॥
iast:
sudurbalaṃ nāvajānāti kaṃcid-
yukto ripuṃ sevate buddhipūrvam |
na vigrahaṃ rocayate balasthaiḥ
kāle ca yo vikramate sa dhīraḥ ||
english: One who despises no one, however weak, deals with an enemy thoughtfully and carefully, does not seek conflict with the strong, and shows courage at the right time, is steadfast.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
प्राप्यापदं न व्यथते कदा चिद्
उद्योगमन्विच्छति चाप्रमत्तः ।
दुःखं च काले सहते जितात्मा
धुरन्धरस्तस्य जिताः सपत्नाः ॥
iast:
prāpyāpadaṃ na vyathate kadā cid
udyogamanvicchati cāpramattaḥ |
duḥkhaṃ ca kāle sahate jitātmā
dhurandharastasya jitāḥ sapatnāḥ ||
english: One who, meeting misfortune, is never shaken, keeps seeking to act with care, and bears suffering in its season with self-mastery: that bearer of burdens has conquered his rivals.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
अनर्थकं विप्र वासं गृहेभ्यः
पापैः सन्धिं परदाराभिमर्शम् ।
दम्भं स्तैन्यं पैशुनं मद्य पानं
न सेवते यः स सुखी सदैव ॥
iast:
anarthakaṃ vipra vāsaṃ gṛhebhyaḥ
pāpaiḥ sandhiṃ paradārābhimarśam |
dambhaṃ stainyaṃ paiśunaṃ madya pānaṃ
na sevate yaḥ sa sukhī sadaiva ||
english: One who does not indulge in pointless living away from home, alliances with the wicked, adultery, hypocrisy, theft, slander or drinking, is always happy.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
न संरम्भेणारभतेऽर्थवर्गम्
आकारितः शंसति तथ्यमेव ।
न मात्रार्थे रोचयते विवादं
नापूजितः कुप्यति चाप्यमूढः ॥
iast:
na saṃrambheṇārabhate'rthavargam
ākāritaḥ śaṃsati tathyameva |
na mātrārthe rocayate vivādaṃ
nāpūjitaḥ kupyati cāpyamūḍhaḥ ||
english: One who does not pursue wealth in haste and agitation, speaks only the truth when called upon, does not seek a quarrel over a trifle, and is not angry when not honoured, is no fool.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
न योऽभ्यसूयत्यनुकम्पते च
न दुर्बलः प्रातिभाव्यं करोति ।
नात्याह किं चित्क्षमते विवादं
सर्वत्र तादृग्लभते प्रशंसाम् ॥
iast:
na yo'bhyasūyatyanukampate ca
na durbalaḥ prātibhāvyaṃ karoti |
nātyāha kiṃ citkṣamate vivādaṃ
sarvatra tādṛglabhate praśaṃsām ||
english: One who is not envious and is compassionate, who, being weak, does not stand surety for others, does not overstate anything and tolerates disputes, wins praise everywhere.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
यो नोद्धतं कुरुते जातु वेषं
न पौरुषेणापि विकत्थतेऽन्यान् ।
न मूर्च्छितः कटुकान्याह किं चित्
प्रियं सदा तं कुरुते जनोऽपि ॥
iast:
yo noddhataṃ kurute jātu veṣaṃ
na pauruṣeṇāpi vikatthate'nyān |
na mūrcchitaḥ kaṭukānyāha kiṃ cit
priyaṃ sadā taṃ kurute jano'pi ||
english: One who never adopts a haughty manner, does not boast of his prowess to others, and, even when beside himself, says nothing bitter, is always loved by people.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
न वैरमुद्दीपयति प्रशान्तं
न दर्ममारोहति नास्तमेति ।
न दुर्गतोऽस्मीति करोति मन्युं
तमार्य शीलं परमाहुरग्र्यम् ॥
iast:
na vairamuddīpayati praśāntaṃ
na darmamārohati nāstameti |
na durgato'smīti karoti manyuṃ
tamārya śīlaṃ paramāhuragryam ||
english: One who does not rekindle enmity that has died down, does not climb into arrogance nor sink down, and does not turn resentful saying 'I am in a bad way': that noble conduct they call the highest.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
न स्वे सुखे वै कुरुते प्रहर्षं
नान्यस्य दुःखे भवति प्रतीतः ।
दत्त्वा न पश्चात्कुरुतेऽनुतापं
न कत्थते सत्पुरुषार्य शीलः ॥
iast:
na sve sukhe vai kurute praharṣaṃ
nānyasya duḥkhe bhavati pratītaḥ |
dattvā na paścātkurute'nutāpaṃ
na katthate satpuruṣārya śīlaḥ ||
english: One who does not exult in his own happiness, does not rejoice at another's sorrow, does not regret having given, and does not boast: that is a good person of noble conduct.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
देशाचारान्समयाञ्जातिधर्मान्
बुभूषते यस्तु परावरज्ञः ।
स तत्र तत्राधिगतः सदैव
महाजनस्याधिपत्यं करोति ॥
iast:
deśācārānsamayāñjātidharmān
bubhūṣate yastu parāvarajñaḥ |
sa tatra tatrādhigataḥ sadaiva
mahājanasyādhipatyaṃ karoti ||
english: One who knows high and low and seeks to understand the customs of regions, conventions and the duties of communities, wherever he goes, always rises to leadership of the people.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
दम्भं मोहं मत्सरं पापकृत्यं
राजद्विष्टं पैशुनं पूगवैरम् ।
मत्तोन्मत्तैर्दुर्जनैश्चापि वादं
यः प्रज्ञावान्वर्जयेत्स प्रधानः ॥
iast:
dambhaṃ mohaṃ matsaraṃ pāpakṛtyaṃ
rājadviṣṭaṃ paiśunaṃ pūgavairam |
mattonmattairdurjanaiścāpi vādaṃ
yaḥ prajñāvānvarjayetsa pradhānaḥ ||
english: The wise one who avoids hypocrisy, delusion, envy, wrong deeds, what the king hates, slander, feuds with groups, and disputes with the drunk, the mad and the wicked, is foremost.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
दमं शौचं दैवतं मङ्गलानि
प्रायश्चित्तं विविधाँल्लोकवादान् ।
एतानि यः कुरुते नैत्यकानि
तस्योत्थानं देवता राधयन्ति ॥
iast:
damaṃ śaucaṃ daivataṃ maṅgalāni
prāyaścittaṃ vividhām̐llokavādān |
etāni yaḥ kurute naityakāni
tasyotthānaṃ devatā rādhayanti ||
english: One who daily practises self-control, purity, worship of the gods, auspicious rites, atonement and the various customs of the world: the gods favour that person's rise.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
समैर्विवाहं कुरुते न हीनैः
समैः सख्यं व्यवहारं कथाश्च ।
गुणैर्विशिष्टांश्च पुरो दधाति
विपश्चितस्तस्य नयाः सुनीताः ॥
iast:
samairvivāhaṃ kurute na hīnaiḥ
samaiḥ sakhyaṃ vyavahāraṃ kathāśca |
guṇairviśiṣṭāṃśca puro dadhāti
vipaścitastasya nayāḥ sunītāḥ ||
english: One who marries among equals and not among inferiors, who makes friends, does business and converses with equals, and puts those of superior qualities first: that wise person's policies are well guided.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
मितं भुङ्क्ते संविभज्याश्रितेभ्यो
मितं स्वपित्यमितं कर्मकृत्वा ।
ददात्यमित्रेष्वपि याचितः सं-
स्तमात्मवन्तं प्रजहात्यनर्थाः ॥
iast:
mitaṃ bhuṅkte saṃvibhajyāśritebhyo
mitaṃ svapityamitaṃ karmakṛtvā |
dadātyamitreṣvapi yācitaḥ saṃ-
stamātmavantaṃ prajahātyanarthāḥ ||
english: One who eats in moderation after sharing with dependants, sleeps little after much work, and gives when asked even to enemies: misfortunes leave such a self-possessed person.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
चिकीर्षितं विप्रकृतं च यस्य
नान्ये जनाः कर्म जानन्ति किं चित् ।
मन्त्रे गुप्ते सम्यगनुष्ठिते च
स्वल्पो नास्य व्यथते कश्चिदर्थः ॥
iast:
cikīrṣitaṃ viprakṛtaṃ ca yasya
nānye janāḥ karma jānanti kiṃ cit |
mantre gupte samyaganuṣṭhite ca
svalpo nāsya vyathate kaścidarthaḥ ||
english: When others know nothing of what one intends or has done, and counsel is kept secret and properly carried out, not even the smallest of one's aims miscarries.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
यः सर्वभूतप्रशमे निविष्टः
सत्यो मृदुर्दानकृच्छुद्ध भावः ।
अतीव सञ्ज्ञायते ज्ञातिमध्ये
महामणिर्जात्य इव प्रसन्नः ॥
iast:
yaḥ sarvabhūtapraśame niviṣṭaḥ
satyo mṛdurdānakṛcchuddha bhāvaḥ |
atīva sañjñāyate jñātimadhye
mahāmaṇirjātya iva prasannaḥ ||
english: One devoted to the calm of all beings, truthful, gentle, generous and pure in heart, is highly respected among kin, like a great gem of fine origin, clear and bright.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
य आत्मनापत्रपते भृशं नरः
स सर्वलोकस्य गुरुर्भवत्युत ।
अनन्त तेजाः सुमनाः समाहितः
स्वतेजसा सूर्य इवावभासते ॥
iast:
ya ātmanāpatrapate bhṛśaṃ naraḥ
sa sarvalokasya gururbhavatyuta |
ananta tejāḥ sumanāḥ samāhitaḥ
svatejasā sūrya ivāvabhāsate ||
english: The person who feels deeply ashamed before himself becomes the teacher of all the world; of endless radiance, glad of heart and collected, he shines by his own light like the sun.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
वने जाताः शापदग्धस्य राज्ञः
पाण्डोः पुत्राः पञ्च पञ्चेन्द्र कल्पाः ।
त्वयैव बाला वर्धिताः शिक्षिताश्च
तवादेशं पालयन्त्याम्बिकेय ॥
iast:
vane jātāḥ śāpadagdhasya rājñaḥ
pāṇḍoḥ putrāḥ pañca pañcendra kalpāḥ |
tvayaiva bālā vardhitāḥ śikṣitāśca
tavādeśaṃ pālayantyāmbikeya ||
english: Born in the forest to King Pandu, who was burnt by a curse, the five sons of Pandu, like five Indras, were raised and taught by you as boys, and they follow your command, son of Ambika.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
प्रदायैषामुचितं तात राज्यं
सुखी पुत्रैः सहितो मोदमानः ।
न देवानां नापि च मानुषाणां
भविष्यसि त्वं तर्कणीयो नरेन्द्र ॥
iast:
pradāyaiṣāmucitaṃ tāta rājyaṃ
sukhī putraiḥ sahito modamānaḥ |
na devānāṃ nāpi ca mānuṣāṇāṃ
bhaviṣyasi tvaṃ tarkaṇīyo narendra ||
english: Give them their due kingdom, dear one, and be happy, rejoicing with your sons. Then, lord of men, you will be blamed by neither gods nor humans.

speaker: Dhritarashtra
devanagari:
जाग्रतो दह्यमानस्य यत्कार्यमनुपश्यसि ।
तद्ब्रूहि त्वं हि नस्तात धर्मार्थकुशलः शुचिः ॥
iast:
jāgrato dahyamānasya yatkāryamanupaśyasi |
tadbrūhi tvaṃ hi nastāta dharmārthakuśalaḥ śuciḥ ||
english: Tell me what you see as needing to be done by one who lies awake, burning; for you, dear one, are skilled in dharma and worldly affairs, and pure.

speaker: Dhritarashtra
devanagari:
त्वं मां यथावद्विदुर प्रशाधि
प्रज्ञा पूर्वं सर्वमजातशत्रोः ।
यन्मन्यसे पथ्यमदीनसत्त्व
श्रेयः करं ब्रूहि तद्वै कुरूणाम् ॥
iast:
tvaṃ māṃ yathāvadvidura praśādhi
prajñā pūrvaṃ sarvamajātaśatroḥ |
yanmanyase pathyamadīnasattva
śreyaḥ karaṃ brūhi tadvai kurūṇām ||
english: Instruct me properly, Vidura, about everything in Ajatashatru's mind. Whatever you think beneficial, you of undaunted spirit, tell me what will bring good to the Kurus.

speaker: Dhritarashtra
devanagari:
पापाशङ्गी पापमेव नौपश्यन्
पृच्छामि त्वां व्याकुलेनात्मनाहम् ।
कवे तन्मे ब्रूहि सर्वं यथावन्
मनीषितं सर्वमजातशत्रोः ॥
iast:
pāpāśaṅgī pāpameva naupaśyan
pṛcchāmi tvāṃ vyākulenātmanāham |
kave tanme brūhi sarvaṃ yathāvan
manīṣitaṃ sarvamajātaśatroḥ ||
english: Fearing wrong, I see nothing but wrong; I ask you with a troubled mind. Seer, tell me everything truly that Ajatashatru intends.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
शुभं वा यदि वा पापं द्वेष्यं वा यदि वा प्रियम् ।
अपृष्टस्तस्य तद्ब्रूयाद्यस्य नेच्छेत्पराभवम् ॥
iast:
śubhaṃ vā yadi vā pāpaṃ dveṣyaṃ vā yadi vā priyam |
apṛṣṭastasya tadbrūyādyasya necchetparābhavam ||
english: Whether good or bad, hateful or pleasant, one should say it even unasked to anyone whose downfall one does not wish.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
तस्माद्वक्ष्यामि ते राजन्भवमिच्छन्कुरून्प्रति ।
वचः श्रेयः करं धर्म्यं ब्रुवतस्तन्निबोध मे ॥
iast:
tasmādvakṣyāmi te rājanbhavamicchankurūnprati |
vacaḥ śreyaḥ karaṃ dharmyaṃ bruvatastannibodha me ||
english: So, king, wishing the Kurus well, I will speak to you words that are beneficial and righteous; listen as I speak.

speaker: Vidura
devanagari:
मिथ्योपेतानि कर्माणि सिध्येयुर्यानि भारत ।
अनुपाय प्रयुक्तानि मा स्म तेषु मनः कृथाः ॥
iast:
mithyopetāni karmāṇi sidhyeyuryāni bhārata |
anupāya prayuktāni mā sma teṣu manaḥ kṛthāḥ ||
english: Do not set your mind on undertakings that are joined with falsehood and pursued by wrong means, Bharata, even if they might succeed.
